title.narrative: Strengthen Memory Institutions in Disaster Risk Reduction and Management

description.narrative: UNESCO will support memory institutions in adopting and implementing emergency preparedness plans in line with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction and the 2015 Recommendation concerning the Preservation of, and Access to, Documentary Heritage Including in Digital Form. This support will be provided, among others, through technical assistance, training, policy guidance, capacity-building activities, tools, resources, and financial assistance aimed at strengthening preparedness and resilience to disasters and climate-related risks affecting documentary heritage. Through the Memory of the World Programme, UNESCO will further advance the implementation of the Sendai Framework by supporting memory institutions with strengthened emergency preparedness and disaster response capacities. A key focus will be policy advocacy for increased investment in resilience-building, particularly in Africa and SIDS, which are among the most vulnerable regions to climate change and natural hazards.
